status: retrospective reuse of public production configurations; specified before this missing-moment reobservation, not before the original target reveal
backend_identity: original engine metadata commit and archived source commit have the same Git backend blob
source: S=(C_blackNN+C_whiteMatching)/N, the same explicit raw source for every geometry
physical_interpretation: For P proportional to Bernoulli(p) exp(lambda*S+h(lambda)*q), h'(0)=-Cov(q,S)/Var(q) keeps the matching mean fixed to first order; d P(rank1)/d lambda=-C.

auxiliary_sources.meaning: OLS source compensation with an intercept, separately refit per geometry and aligned delete-one; these are geometry-adapted sources, not one universal operator. Adding h*q to hold q fixed does not also keep all original controls fixed.

identity_fields: batch sample count and q,E,S,K,KK,T,chi first moments are retained to match the original saved sufficient statistics during the single analysis
uncertainty: 100 aligned equal-size delete-one batches per N; remove both directions together and refit all nonlinear projections; save all vectors and full output covariance
direction: (first-second)/exact Delta cos(4theta), with no fitted exponent
joint_zero: Report nominal two-size zero statistics separately for H4 C and J_E under each declared raw/clock/full source; N-domain-separated PRNG assumption, never independent votes across views
sector_identity: E[S|q]=a+b*q+c*q^2; C=c*(Var(E_top)-Cov(E_top,q)^2/Var(q)). Nonzero C rejects a pure q tangent only in this finite topological marginal, not a continuum field theory.
resources: one local CPU deterministic reobservation per N, no GPU/server/tunnel or test suite
report_shape: Repository technical Markdown with result-first summary, definitions, actual response and direction evidence, method/uncertainty, physical boundary and discriminating next question. A two-size numerical readout needs no scaling chart.
